title: Home page layout
question: The look is set (shot 1 colors, your Higgsfield loop, your photo lit blue and red). Pick how the home page is arranged. All three fit on one screen, no long scroll.

options.label: Title sequence
options.thesis: The home page opens like a film title: your name, huge, over the video, then one typed line.
options.viewport: Video full screen, portrait centered behind a giant condensed name, typed line under it, three glass page tabs along the bottom edge.
options.risk: Most cinematic, but the live GitHub panel has to live one step down or on Projects.

options.label: Horizon
options.thesis: The particle wave becomes the floor: you stand on it, and the page links rest on it.
options.viewport: Headline top left, portrait right of center rising from the wave, three glass doors and a live GitHub strip sitting along the horizon.
options.risk: Ties the layout to this one clip; a new video must keep a horizon in the same spot.

options.label: HUD frame
options.thesis: The screen is a framed instrument view, with live readouts from your GitHub on its edges.
options.viewport: Corner-bracket frame, portrait center in front of a giant last name, mono readout columns left and right, glass nav pill top center.
options.risk: Busiest of the three; on phones the readouts collapse to one line.
